transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Before I sign Thursday's airlift manifest, I need to confirm whether operations, signal, and medical have any changes to their standard pallet requests. As a reminder, the contracted airlift has capacity for exactly 23 standard pallets. The normal weekly request is 8 pallets of engineering materiel, 5 pallets of communications batteries, and 5 pallets of medical supplies, totaling 18 pallets with 5 unused spaces available. Please report any current changes to your standard pallet requests now so I can finalize the manifest and loading instructions.
